purpose: Current browser-platform source check for the rev0201 package-src allowlist and storage-privacy posture change.
scope: FROST OPFS SSD timing side-channel research

sources.name: MDN Origin private file system
sources.observed: OPFS is origin-private, worker-available, quota-bound origin storage; clearing site storage deletes OPFS; it is not user-visible and does not require permission prompts/security checks.

sources.name: MDN Storage API
sources.observed: Storage API reports available/used space and persistence posture; StorageManager.estimate() remains an estimate, not a reservation.

sources.name: W3C Web Locks API
sources.observed: AbortSignal rejects a lock request only before the lock is granted; once granted, the signal is ignored, so provider lifecycle cancellation still matters.

sources.name: Chrome for Developers: Storage Buckets
sources.observed: Storage Buckets are available from Chromium 122 and make eviction behavior more granular, but they are a capability branch rather than a baseline BrowserRT guarantee.

sources.name: FROST: Fingerprinting Remotely using OPFS-based SSD Timing
sources.observed: 2026 research demonstrates OPFS can be used from browser JavaScript for SSD-contention timing/fingerprinting on evaluated systems; BrowserRT should treat large planned OPFS writes as a privacy-review trigger, not claim mitigation.

sources.name: Graz University of Technology FROST publication record
sources.observed: Peer-reviewed DIMVA 2026 record for the FROST OPFS timing work.

implications: Do not widen runtime-core or package budgets to absorb research commentary; put current research into a small retained research artifact and enforce code posture with probes.
Keep OPFS non-claims explicit: no quota reservation, eviction survival, fsync/power-loss durability, privacy/fingerprinting mitigation, or cross-browser matrix claim.
Storage privacy posture should be advisory and triggered by planned OPFS write size/ratio; it should not pretend to measure SSD timing or prevent FROST-class attacks.
Storage Buckets support should remain a future capability/posture branch unless a browser proof demonstrates the behavior.
nonClaims: Research artifact is not a legal/security guarantee, browser-vendor commitment, or claim that BrowserRT mitigates SSD timing side channels.
